decisions.adr: 0439 — The shape a lossy name makes and where else it lived
decisions.decision: Extend coverage through the public named-destination consumer; helper-only byte tests do not establish end-to-end byte identity.
decisions.basis: The new draft gives composed and decomposed spellings distinct exact byte keys, distinct indirect destination values, a prefix key, exact child Limits and indirect Kids. It preserves the existing ASCII positive cases and adds absent-byte negatives.
decisions.status: Draft only; parent must review and execute. No current runtime failure is claimed.

decisions.decision: Retain the shared tree algorithm; no new algorithmic defect is established. Add the multibyte case to the previously added deep public fixture.
decisions.basis: The fixture is root→intermediate→leaf and separates routing ranges from Unicode spelling. Independent literal page indices are the oracle.
decisions.residuals: No review of generic enumeration or every consumer.

decisions.adr: 0252 — The errata were in the file all along, and the conversion dropped them
decisions.decision: Use the annotation-aware primary source for #214 and avoid the removed lexical label as the basis of a Unicode comparator claim.
decisions.basis: The effective text retains byte equality, self-consistent encoding and common-prefix ordering; the fixture directly tests encoded byte distinctions.

date_consumer_review: No new date test: current parse/default/zone/instant assertions and independently guarded metadata writer regressions cover the plausible boundaries inspected. This is a bounded decision, not complete review of every date property consumer.
